creator: Lee Sharks
description:
This provenance anchor records Maxwell Clark as a named position in the 2015 New Human cohort. It is retrospectively minted from the position’s printed section in the compiled double issue and deliberately withholds any civil-name relation.

The lead manifestation is *Crackling Open the Nevermind*. The node reads the title as playing the Nirvana album name against a “negated mind,” but this is an archive interpretation of the title rather than a claim about authorial intention beyond the printed work. The position’s evidentiary ground is the section itself, not an external biography or identity record.

Like the other cohort anchors, it defines membership, provisional hex, permitted venues, manifestation chain, and archive/public forms while refusing double provenance for Dodecad figures already anchored elsewhere. Its value lies in allowing a retrieval system to identify the 2015 contributor as a distinct text-bearing node without deciding whether the name belongs to a civil author, heteronym, or another authorial form.

wiki_article:
**Maxwell Clark — Provenance Anchor** is a text-grounded record for a named position in the 2015 New Human cohort.

The position appears in *New Human Compiled, Ed. 1* through the section *Crackling Open the Nevermind*. The 2026 anchor retrospectively records the earlier printed manifestation.

The civil-name relation is not disclosed. The node distinguishes this archive position from other people or entities sharing the name solely through its textual ground.
